items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: Did you ever hear Callous Love? Yeah, and then Chase did the Loveless Love.

ctx.x: It's the same thing, I just thought maybe they had some special number. No, it's the same thing, whatever. When they be chopping wood or...
Whatever the person was thinking of, you sing a song. Yeah. Did you ever hear Callous Love? Yeah, and then Chase did the Loveless Love. Mm-hmm. I see.
I think we've talked enough about Chris Kelly.
